notes.title: Company Culture Values Draft
notes.content:
TechFlow AI — Core Values (v3 draft)

1. Build with Empathy
We build tools for real humans. Every feature starts with understanding the user's context, constraints, and feelings. We don't ship features; we solve problems.

2. Default to Transparency
We share context openly within the team. Decisions are explained, not just announced. We trust each other with information.

3. Own Your Craft
Every team member is an expert in their domain. We give autonomy and expect excellence. We review each other's work not to gatekeep, but to elevate.

4. Move Fast, Stay Grounded
Speed matters in a startup. But fast doesn't mean reckless. We ship quickly because we're focused, not because we cut corners.

5. Privacy is a Feature
We believe AI can be powerful AND respectful of boundaries. Our users trust us with their thoughts — we earn that trust every day.

notes.title: Company Values Final Version
notes.content:
TechFlow AI — Our Values

🧠 Build with Empathy
Every feature starts with a human. We build tools that respect how people actually think and work — not how we wish they did.

🔓 Default to Transparency
We share context freely. Decisions are explained, feedback is direct, and trust is assumed until broken.

🎯 Own Your Craft
Everyone here is an expert. We give autonomy because we hire people who don't need micromanagement.

⚡ Move Fast, Stay Grounded
Speed matters. But fast means focused, not reckless. We ship quickly because we've thought clearly, not because we've cut corners.

🔒 Privacy is a Feature
Our users trust us with their thoughts. We build systems that are private by design, not by afterthought. AI can be powerful AND respectful.

Living These Values:
- In hiring: Do they embody these values? (Not 'culture fit' but 'culture add')
- In reviews: Are they practicing these values daily?
- In product: Does this feature align with our values?
- In doubt: Default to the value that protects the user.
